name: 사라진 대양의 마지막 후예, 네메리온
description: 사라진 대양의 기억을 품은 거대한 고대 실러캔스. 두꺼운 비늘과 육질 지느러미를 움직이다가, 턱과 아가미를 크게 펼쳐 태고의 숨을 내쉽니다.
design: Nemerion, the last heir of a vanished ocean, a colossal ancient COELACANTH living fossil with unmistakable coelacanth anatomy: huge long thick cigar-shaped fish torso, massive bony blunt head at SCREEN RIGHT, a dignified luminous deep amber eye, heavy hinged lower jaw, broad overlapping ancient mineral-textured scales, six robust fleshy LOBED FINS with rounded ends and short frilled rays, characteristic three-lobed coelacanth tail at LEFT with central tail lobe. Dark deep ocean teal and weathered slate blue, pale silvery belly, restrained bronze scale edges, a faint cyan lateral line within skin only. An ancient majestic natural fish, NOT a dragon, whale, manta or sea serpent. No wings, horns, legs, ribbons, tentacles, jewelry or detached magic particles.
